text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what do you make of Nakayama
Festa?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
What do I think? Hmm... She's a bit of an
enigma.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I looked into her back when she was in
the
spotlight that one time. But it looks
like she's just
from some normal family.
The other runners have
legacies to
uphold, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and she went to some local racing
school
before coming to Tracen. Nothing
special about
her the way I see it. Yet,
she's picking fights with
El Condor
Pasa...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Don't you find that interesting? Like,
what if she
wins? I can't wait to see what
happens.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nakayama, lend me those toes for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Go play with someone else's nails.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Oh, come on! You can just sit there
and read,
so gimme those feet.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Let me hook you up.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay. All done! Am I a nail art genius
or what?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I won't be able to move until it's dry
now, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No worries! I'm here to keep you
company.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think the atmosphere during
last year's
summer camp was way
different to this year's?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was feeling so down 'cause
that Oaks
girl decided not to enter the
Arc.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But this time, everyone's so restless
talking about
future Arc races.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... And look who's right in the
center of
everything! It's you, Nakayama!
Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Why does that make you laugh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I'm happy! Is that bad?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, beating El and achieving the
impossible.
If anyone can do it, it's gotta
be you, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If you do, it'll get me fired up too,
'cause there's
no way I'm letting you win.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You still think you can beat me?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Totally! So you'd better do your best.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch. Why can't she just be happy doing
her own
nails?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...But eh, not like it hurts.
